    - title: "VSCodium"
      path: https://vscodium.com/
      description: "A build of VS Code without Microsoft's telemetry and branding. Our default editor from Session 3. Open a folder, not a file."

      categories: [editor, install]
    - title: "Obsidian"
      path: https://obsidian.md/download
      description: "Note archive built on a plain folder of Markdown files on your own disk. Linked notes, tags, plugins — including a Zotero integration."
      date: 2026-09-29
      categories: [notes, install]

      path: https://git-scm.com/
      description: "Version control. Install it in Session 3; you will use it every week afterwards. The Pro Git book is free and the first three chapters are enough."

      categories: [tool, install]

      path: https://github.com/

Everything the Lab installs, calls or relies on, roughly in the order it comes up. Items tagged
**install** need to be on your own laptop.

The [Intro](https://dhbern.github.io/introduction-to-dh/contents/resources.html) keeps a
complementary list of tools and reference works.

::: {#toolbox}
:::

## Contribute

Found something better? Open an [issue](https://github.com/DHBern/dh-lab/issues/new/choose) or a
pull request. Tools suggested by participants are credited.
